data.job_title: Senior Industrial Account Manager (5+ years of CNC industry experience required)
data.description:
**The Opportunity**  
At Gesswein, we’re on a mission to help precision manufacturing industries achieve better results—by supplying precision tools, advanced equipment, and hands-on training. As an Account Manager, you’ll be on the front lines of this mission, providing sales and service to our top industrial accounts throughout the United States.

You are the right person if you are driven to increase sales, strengthen customer relationships, and work in a team environment. This role requires general knowledge of industrial manufacturing and strong communication skills. This is a remote position and will require weekly travel to visit accounts within the Midwestern US.

**What You'll Do**

- Manage key industrial accounts in the Midwest
- Be an integral member of Gesswein’s sales & technical team
- Travel the U.S. for tradeshows, customer visits, and technical training
- Field customer inquiries through phone, email, and web.
- Provide answers and solutions to customers in a timely manner.

**What We’re Looking For**

- 5-years’ experience in the industrial precision manufacturing industry
- Proven record of sales achievements
- Clear communicator with strong organizational skills
- Ability to learn new IT Platforms quickly, such as ERP, CRM, Excel, and email
- Flexibility to travel the U.S. for sales activities, including tradeshows

**About Gesswein**  
Gesswein is a fourth-generation family-owned business serving metalworking industries throughout the U.S. and around the world since 1914. We supply an extensive product line of 15,000+ high-quality precision tools and equipment from our main office in Bridgeport, CT. Gesswein is ranked a Top Workplace in Southern Connecticut.

**Benefits**

- Health, Dental & Vision
- Health Savings Account
- Life Insurance, STD, LTD, ADD
- 401(k)
- Paid time off and holidays

Job Types: Full-time, Commission

Pay: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Benefits:

- 401(k)
- Dental insurance
- Health insurance
- Health savings account
- Life insurance
- Paid time off
- Vision insurance

Experience:

- Account Management in CNC field: 5 years (Required)

Willingness to travel:

- 50% (Required)

Work Location: Remote

company_object.long_description:
We are a fourth-generation family-owned business serving metalworkers in the jewelry and tool & die trades. Our specialty is supplying precision metalworking tools and equipment. Our passion is helping our customers achieve better results.

We manufacture and distribute an extensive product line of over 15,000+ high quality tools and advanced technical equipment from our main headquarters in Connecticut. We also have distribution centers in Canada, India, and Thailand to help reach our broader global market.

Our mission is to empower metalworkers with the best tools and technique to reach new heights of success. With a meticulously curated product line and dedicated support team, we stand by your side.

TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
This Incident Support team manages complex breach, fraud, and identity theft incidents, providing expert guidance and support to clients, impacted individuals, and internal partners. They coordinate sensitive and high-priority cases, help improve incident response processes, and provide coaching and expertise to the broader team. This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.
  
  
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
The Bilingual Associate Lead - Incident Coordinator is responsible for managing complex breach, fraud and identity theft cases while serving as a subject matter expert for clients, internal teams and impacted individuals. This role requires advanced analytical skills, exceptional communication and the ability to lead high priority or high‑sensitivity incidents. The incumbent contributes to operational excellence, supports continuous improvement efforts and provides coaching and guidance to other team members.
  
  
**Incident & Customer Management**

- Conduct detailed customer interviews to gather required information related to breach, fraud or identity theft events.
- Analyze case details to determine severity, scope and appropriate remediation actions.
- Independently manage high‑complexity and escalated incidents, ensuring timely resolution and adherence to client requirements.
- Serve as the point of contact for customers, clients and internal experts throughout the lifecycle of an incident.
- Provide clear, professional and empathetic communication regarding services, expectations and next steps.
- Coordinate with internal teams such as Forensics, Privacy, Legal and Operations to support complex investigations.
- Assemble and preserve documentation, statements and timelines for use in remediation or claims processes.
- Escalate issues requiring additional expertise and lead cross‑functional discussions and updates.

**Client Support & Subject-Matter Expertise**

- Provide guidance on fraud trends, breach impact and best‑practice response methods.
- Assist where requested with new client Implementation tasks.

**Operational & Administrative Responsibilities**

- Assist to Identify and communicate incident trends, emerging risks, and unique client issues to internal stakeholders.
- Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards related to breaches and identity theft.
- Support project scheduling, tracking, and reporting activities.
- Oversee secure document and data transfers between the company and clients.
- Record accurate, complete case notes and ensure timely case closure and final reporting.
- Drive efficiency and consistency across the incident management process.

**Leadership & Team Development**

- Support with mentorship, guidance and informal training to junior level Incident Coordinators.
- Support onboarding through job‑shadowing, process guidance and knowledge sharing.
- Conduct QA and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and compliance in case management.

**Quality, Compliance & Governance**

- Support internal and external audit activities, including preparation of necessary documentation.
- Monitor adherence to regulatory requirements, operational processes and client commitments.
- Identify risks or gaps and escalate appropriately.

**Continuous Improvement & SME Contribution**

- Recommend and support improvements to workflows, tools, templates and procedures.
- Participate in pilot programs, process testing and system rollouts.
- Contribute to SOP updates, and knowledge-base content.

**Language Responsibilities**

- Review translated materials for accuracy and clarity when acting as language SME.
- Assist French language clients with understanding any English only documents from our IRF/BFE teams.

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

- A university degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
- French proficiency is a must have - both verbal and written as well as experience working in a bilingual capacity.
- Minimum of 5+ years of experience in a role of similar capacity.
- Experience in credit industry is preferred.
- Strong analytical, communication and problem‑solving skills.
- Ability to manage high‑volume and high‑complexity cases with minimal supervision.
- Demonstrated experience in breach, fraud, identity theft or related investigative work.
- High level of professionalism, discretion and customer empathy.
- Ability to work cross‑functionally and manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and communication.
- Collaborate with Team Leads and Managers for any ad hoc items that arise due to business needs.

The expected pay range for this position is $55,000 - $70,000 annually. The pay information provided for this position reflects a reasonable estimate of the range of expected compensation for this job. At TransUnion, actual compensation is based on careful consideration of many factors such as (but not limited to) an individual’s education, training, work experience, job related skill set, location, and industry knowledge, as well as the scope and responsibilities of the position and market considerations. In addition, variable compensation is based on applicable company guidance and plan documents as well as performance.
  
  
This job posting is for an existing vacancy. The opening is to backfill a previously held position.
  
  
*Accommodation is available, including for applicants with disabilities, in accordance with applicable laws.*
**TransUnion Overview**

company_object.name: TransUnion
company_object.long_description:
TransUnion is a global information and insights company that makes trust possible in the modern economy. We do this by providing an actionable picture of each person so they can be reliably represented in the marketplace.  As a result, businesses and consumers can transact with confidence and achieve great things.  

This picture is grounded in our legacy as a credit reporting agency which enables us to tap into both credit and public record data; our data fusion methodology that helps us link, match and tap into the awesome combined power of that data; and our knowledgeable and passionate team, who stewards the information with expertise, and in accordance with local legislation around the world. 

A leading presence in more than 30 countries across five continents, TransUnion provides solutions that help create economic opportunity, great experiences and personal empowerment for hundreds of millions of people.

We call this Information for Good®—it’s our purpose, and what drives us every day.
